text_block_list.text:
――Summer arrived.
Uma Musume gathered at beach camp,
pushing limits in training.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!

Under blazing sun, Narita Top Road ran,
sharpening her speed step by step.

text_block_list.name: Uma Musume Classmates
text_block_list.text: Class Rep Top Road! Keep it up~~!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ! Yaaaaaaa——!

――Driven by desire to meet everyone's
expectations, her energy knew no bounds.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san,
thank you so much for today's guidance!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Tomorrow's plan……oh, right! Trainer-san,
do you have plans for later?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking of checking out local summer
festival for change of pace! If you're free,
want to come along?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, that sauce smells amazing! Trainer-san,
what should we grab first?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Okonomiyaki or yakisoba…… Huh?
Aren't those girls……?

text_block_list.name: Uma Musume Classmates
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Class Rep Top Road! Perfect timing!
Please help us~!

Several dejected Uma Musume stood huddled
around shooting gallery stall—
classmates of Narita Top Road.

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
We've been aiming for that fireworks set,
but none of us can knock it down!
We just wanted to do fireworks together~~!

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text: Class Rep Top Road! Can you win it for us?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Eh? Me?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
……To knock that box down,
you need to hit top right corner……
But……pinpoint aim isn't really my strong
suit……

text_block_list.name: Uma Musume Classmates
text_block_list.text: Class Rep, please!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ――Alright! I'll give it a shot!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Target top right…………There! ――Ah, missed……

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Next one for sure…………Take that! ――Wah,
went high…………One more!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: …………Darn it. Only one shot left……

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(What do I do,
everyone's counting on me…… I can't let them
down……but……!)
My eyes met Narita Top Road's.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san! 
Could you give me some tips on how to
shoot?

First, had her lower gun since 
she strained so hard. Needed to support 
gun not just with arms, but entire body.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Support with body...
Got it! I'll try again!
choice_data_list: And brace yourself when you fire

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Got it!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: All right...! Here goes!
(Pop... Thump!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ...I did it...!

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
You hit it~~~! 
Thanks so much, Class Rep~~!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! 
You're very welcome!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe. So glad...!

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Class Rep, join us for sparklers! 
We picked spot with view of fireworks,
so double fireworks display!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ah, gladly! 
Let's go, Trainer-san!

Chaperoned Uma Musume playing with
sparklers. 
Narita Top Road ran over from center of
group.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san, won't you join in too? 
You made this all possible, after all!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Just watching...? 
......

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, I see. 
Everyone looks like they're having fun,
right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. ...You always treat everything 
I care about with same importance.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...Back at amusement park, 
you said,
"Don't hesitate to rely on me," right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
choice_data_list: And you end up working way too hard
And you end up working way too hard

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, true. When people count on me, 
just makes me so happy... even if hard, 
doesn't bother me at all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
But you made me realize doing things
alone 
isn't always best choice.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
—Relying on others is fine. 
Working together is fine!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san, 
I want to live up to everyone's
expectations.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Will you help me? 
...Together, from now on!

Fireworks went off overhead. 
Both of us gazed at the lively scene.
